ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central field comprising approximately 75% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and peduncle base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across both lobes. Low-intensity black borders follow the entire trailing edge and outer tips. Dark pigmentation at the fluke-peduncle junction extends upward in a narrow vertical formation. Small, high-contrast dark speckles are distributed across the white ventral field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch depth is distinct and sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Variable frequency serrations; low-amplitude irregularities along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys on the distal lobes, particularly the far-left tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a general convex curve from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of dark, irregular pixel groups on the extreme outer tip of the left lobe. Scattered dark circular spots (approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter) are visible across the white surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the inner-medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged scarring on the distal margin of the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A narrow, dark vertical pigmentation streak extending from the peduncle base toward the median notch.
